name: Zum Stoaner
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Zum Stoaner in the Kleinboden district of Fügen in the Zillertal valley – Kleinbodenerstraße 148, 6263 Fügen.
beschreibung: The Gasthof Zum Stoaner is located in the Kleinboden district of the municipality of Fügen in the Zillertal valley, Schwaz district. The address is Kleinbodenerstraße 148, 6263 Fügen. The establishment is considered a long-standing inn of the village and is listed in regional directories among the restaurants of Fügen. In 2021, the business was taken over by new tenants and reopened; a children's playground adjoins the guesthouse. Fügen lies at the entrance to the Zillertal valley and belongs to the Fügen-Kaltenbach holiday region, where the thermal baths, the Spieljochbahn cable car, and the golf course in Uderns are among the well-known facilities.
